SELECT p.id, p.user_id, p.author_name, p.title, p.is_notice, p.is_secret, p.is_hidden, p.view_count, p.created_at, p.updated_at, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count, CASE WHEN p.author_name = '익명' THEN NULL ELSE u.login_id END AS login_id FROM posts p LEFT JOIN users u ON u.id = p.user_id
p.is_hidden = FALSE
ORDER BY p.is_notice DESC, p.created_at DESC
SELECT p.*, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM comments c WHERE c.post_id = p.id) AS comment_count FROM posts p WHERE p.id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO posts (user_id, author_name, password_hash, title, content, is_notice, is_secret) VALUES (#{userId}, #{authorName}, #{passwordHash}, #{title}, #{content}, #{isNotice}, #{isSecret})
mapper.update: UPDATE posts SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, is_notice = #{isNotice}, is_secret = #{isSecret}, is_hidden = #{isHidden}, password_hash = #{passwordHash}, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE posts SET view_count = view_count + 1 WHERE id = #{id}
